title: Ozonia
description: Ozonia is a 32-map Doom II megawad and the third installment in the Moonblood series, created primarily by Tomás Soares. Inspired heavily by The Plutonia Experiment, it features short levels centered on exploration, low enemy counts, and strategic setpiece encounters. The mapset introduces two custom monsters, the Hierophant and the Hellion, alongside a custom soundtrack composed mostly by Soares.
